title: RBI reviews lending norms for Urban Co-operative Banks (UCBs)
summary: RBI proposed revising aggregate ceiling for unsecured advances by UCBs to 20% of total advances (from 10% of assets) and consumer durables loan limit to ₹2.5 lakh.
